name: Wildcard Hero Frostchaser is usable after every target dodge, not just the first (#6327)
contract: Frostchaser 907700 ('Only usable after the target dodges') has CasterAuraState 24, Ascension's target-dodged
state that Unit::ProcDamageAndSpellFor sets for any player attacker on a dodge and clears after the reactive
timer. A Wildcard Hero with ample rage must be refused before any dodge (SPELL_FAILED_CASTER_AURASTATE 22),
then strike after a dodge, and strike again after a later dodge once its 5 s cooldown is over.

The target gets QA Test 100% Dodge 10020 through the GM '.aura' command on the selected fixture creature (set_aura owned_entry needs a spell-summoned owned creature), so every native swing is dodged; Frostchaser itself has SPELL_ATTR0_NO_ACTIVE_DEFENSE and cannot be dodged.

The hero has melee hit rating so a Frostchaser hit cannot miss: the first rerun's third cast sent no SMSG_CAST_FAILED (so the target-dodged state 24 check passed) yet dealt no damage, which a yellow-hit miss explains. The spell_go_count asserts separate 'the cast went off' from 'it landed'.

steps.label: Before any dodge Frostchaser is refused on the caster aura state
DIAG: Frostchaser cast 2 goes off (not queued or refused)
